usage.callShape: GET https://api.strale.io/x402/stock-quote?symbol=AAPL (required query param: symbol = ticker symbol)
usage.outputShape: body.price, body.name, body.symbol, body.change, body.change_percent, body.open, body.high, body.low, body.volume, body.previous_close, body.currency, body.exchange, body.trading_date; payment/provenance under body._meta
quirks: Required query param is `symbol` (the ticker). Supports US tickers (AAPL) and exchange-suffixed tickers (e.g. VOLV-B.ST).
Data sourced from finance.yahoo.com; market_state may be null.
usage.guide: Make a GET request to https://api.strale.io/x402/stock-quote with the required query parameter `symbol` set to the ticker (e.g. ?symbol=AAPL). Pay via x402 (USDC on Base, ~$0.054/call). The response is a plain JSON object with the quote: read body.price for the current price, body.change / body.change_percent for movement, and body.name/body.symbol for identification. Provenance and settlement info are under body._meta.
